THE RULES OF THE GULLY

A little chase. A lot of character.

Chor wins by delivering three treasures, one at a time, to the green safehouse. Cop wins with three tags or when the two-minute clock runs out.

  • Move: WASD or arrows. Hold Shift to sprint. Energy recharges when you slow down; chai cups restore it.
  • Persuade: Stand by a numbered treasure and press E. Read its wish and choose 1, 2 or 3. A bad offer makes noise. Keep your promise alive with F when trust falls.
  • Rooftops: Space at an amber ladder climbs up or down. On a roof, face a nearby roof and press Space to leap. Each jump costs 18 energy. Ground patrols cannot tag you there. Deliveries happen on the ground.
  • Hide: E beside either chair at Chai & Gossip makes you invisible and untouchable. E leaves. Sitting restores energy but never stops the clock.
  • Cop: Space throws a short-range net every five seconds. Follow visible noise rings, patrol car sightings, and the chor's route.
  • Two players: P1 chor uses WASD, Shift, E, F, Q, Space and 1–3. P2 cop uses arrows, / to sprint and Enter to net. Play together on one keyboard; use Online to play from two separate browsers.
  • Map & breaks: M toggles overview. P or Escape pauses. Switching away pauses automatically. Fullscreen is available when your browser supports it.

Five opinionated treasures

Chef Seeti whistles loudest. Sir Jeet-a-Lot is heavier. Samosa Singh travels light but calls for chutney. Bol Bachchan Radio carries farther chatter. Chappal Express grants a short speed burst on pickup. Three different treasures appear in three different districts each round.

A different gully each time

Two timed events bring extra chai, speed chutney or a false radio call. Online creates a live two-player room with a join link. A challenge invitation shares the same loot, events and light for separate solo runs. Rematch makes a fresh challenge.
